text.p: VIENNA, July 21 (Reuter) The main stories in the Austrian press this Monday are:
- The floods in Austria receded slightly on Sunday.
- Social Affairs Minister Lore Hostasch is working on a draft law whereby the unemployed would be permitted to earn extra without losing their unemployment benefits.
- Current affairs magazine Profil says Steyr-Daimler-Puch is in talks with the Botswanan army over delivering the African state 32 tanks.
- Survey finds that 33 percent of the population want another candidate for president than the current President Thomas Klestil, while 30 percent want him re-elected.
- The appreciation of the dollar and sterling, combined with higher cocoa prices, has led to a 36 percent increase in the price of cocoa in Austria in July from the year-ago period.
- Ferdinand Lacina, former finance minister, urges for more flexibility to fight rising unemployment.
- Analysts expect the rally on the Vienna Stock Exchange to continue this week although they cannot rule out a brief retreat due to consolidation.
